notes: DISCOVERED during the new-home-sales-2026-10-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), one day after the proposer and in the same 10:00 Census slot. It is the STOCK side of the same housing market the calendar otherwise tracks only as flow: homeowner and rental vacancy rates and the homeownership rate, none of which the calendar has an entry for. It matters to the proposer's standing `This quarter` read, which is an inventory-overhang argument — new houses for sale at 488,000 are 85.3% of their July-2006 all-time peak and the highest since December 2007, against sales at 43.7% of theirs — and the HVS vacancy rates are the independent check on whether that overhang is showing up in the occupied stock. It lands on the FOMC decision day (October 27-28 meeting, decision 10-28; federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar fetched 2026-09-06), where the proposer's own tape work measured session ranges materially WIDER than baseline across every instrument tested (ITB 3.154% vs 2.012%, p<0.0001) — so any move that morning belongs to the Fed and this release would be unreadable against it. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06), the series is a household-survey estimate with wide sampling error, and no instrument attaches.
